status: TX26/RX27 is a working baseline from OTA Xiaozhi and V5; schematic net names and public BSP point the opposite way and the conflict is not statically resolved

factory_bsp_config.mapping_assumption: interprets the four words in public-BSP order mclk,bclk,ws,dout,din; the factory BSP struct field order was not recovered from type information

public_bsp_current_source.assessment: conflicts with the OTA Xiaozhi ctor and the V5 observation; it is self-consistent with the schematic net names

schematic_net_names.conflict: literal net names and public BSP imply RX26/TX27; OTA ctor and V5 imply TX26/RX27

recommendation.note: Use RX27/TX26 as the working baseline for microphone bring-up; do not blindly merge the public BSP source swap or flip either direction without a speaker A/B or logic-analyzer test.

caveats: Factory app AIChats is a launcher; the actual voice stack is in ota_0 Xiaozhi.
Factory BSP sample rate 22050 is not necessarily the Xiaozhi voice sample rate.
Public BSP declares bsp_audio_codec_microphone_init() but does not implement it.
The schematic labels GPIO26 as ASDOUT and GPIO27 as DSDIN, which is the opposite of the working baseline; this is an unresolved schematic/firmware/board conflict.
Factory I2S struct field order is assumed from the public BSP, not recovered from type information.
Re-verify pin mapping on the exact board revision before production.
OTA Xiaozhi uses a duplex 24 kHz codec; cross-check the desired Brookesia sample rate before copying it.
